title: Tamsin and the Orchard
author: Freya Coldharbour
blurb: Tamsin Ashgrove, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
